description.value:
Requirements You are in Blight-Shape.

Change from your current Blight-Shape form to another form you have unlocked, using a single action rather than Dismissing and re-shaping. The new form arrives with its own statistics and whichever load the needle is currently paying, exactly as if you had shaped into it. Anything that renews each round — Thicketback's temporary Hit Points, for one — begins renewing on the new form from this round; anything already spent stays spent.
